E-commerce Sales Surge Amid Festive Season, Smartphone Outlook Mixed

E-commerce sales during India's festive season reached ₹24,000 crore in two days, with mobile phones and electronics being top sellers. However, a separate projection indicates that festive smartphone sales may drop by 12% in 2026, according to Counterpoint Research.
